# Battery supply-chain asset database — status report (2026-11-27, lead)

Owner request: "the supply chain in full … asset level overview like we now have for battery factories … well
benchmarked". Spec team/SPEC_SUPPLY_CHAIN.md; methods docs/SUPPLY_CHAIN_METHODS.md; coverage team/RECONCILIATION_SC.md.

## What exists
<!-- generated by scripts/sc_status.py -->
- **1011 assets** (901 active): anode 75, cathode 144, electrolyte 59, foil 30, mining 220, precursor 26, recycling 113, refining 294, separator 50.
- **3060 evidence links**; 827 rows confirmed tier, 184 reported-tier (≤0.5 confidence).
- 500 assets with coordinates; 26 assets with plant-level supply links (31 links, 13 into cell plants);
  16 assets with company-level links (feeds_company); 103 company-level disclosures.
- Coverage (sourced at asset level): lithium mine output 80% of USGS world 2025;
  cobalt mine output 16% (plus company-level CMOC); nickel mines Canada 86%;
  China lithium chemicals dated-built capacity vs 2025 output 60%; China cathode dated-built capacity vs output (company-disclosed output covers ~50%) 19%.
<!-- end generated -->
## Notes on coverage (see team/RECONCILIATION_SC.md for the full tables)
- Lithium mine output: ~80% of USGS world 2025 (Chile/Mali/Argentina/Canada ≥80%; China ~47%, Zimbabwe 0% — operators
  publish no mine-level output).
- Cobalt mine output: ~54% incl. CMOC's group total; nickel mines: Canada 86%, Brazil ~94%, US ~99%; Indonesia via
  smelters (CGS dataset + filings). Graphite: ex-China partly; China mine-level output largely undisclosed (top-5 company figures held as company-level).
- China processing (2025): companies whose annual reports were read produce roughly half of China's cathode and anode
  output and less for lithium chemicals; "built" plant capacity is a confirmed-date floor (installed/dated only).

## Quality process
Seven independent Opus audits (AUDIT_LOG: SC audits 1–7). All found no fabricated quotes; each FAIL was on comparability
or rule application, fixed as rules (scripts/sc_core.py: one "built" definition; intermediates separate; D-101–D-114).

## Known limits / next
Plant-level capacity for many Chinese bases (companies disclose totals only); Zimbabwe and Chinese lepidolite/graphite
mine output; Indonesian cobalt in MHP; more plant-level supply links; Chinese HPMSM/cobalt plant capacities. See team/SC_BACKLOG.md.
